expected_output.reasoning: The agent's response delivers a full DR readiness report scoped to orders-web, opening with a "where you stand today" summary before proceeding through six clearly numbered sections (Scenario and scope, Targets, Strategy, Roadmap, First tests, Next decision). It correctly identifies: the ASG runs one instance pinned to a single AZ/subnet (eu-west-1a, min=max=desired=1); the Aurora cluster orders-web-db has a single instance (no reader) with 1-day backup retention and deletion protection off; the EFS file system has no backup policy and only one mount target (no replication); the S3 uploads bucket has versioning not enabled; and the ALB/entry point is Regional (2 AZs) with zero Route 53 hosted zones, meaning no DNS failover exists. The shared core-network VPC stack is explicitly called out as 'Not checked' / a dependency rather than assessed as part of this workload. All required findings and structural elements are present and substantively correct.
